name: Tenrai API
description:
Tenrai is a free **Unofficial** public REST API for the full MyAnimeList public catalogue. Anime, manga, characters, people, producers, seasons, and more. Tenrai was built because MyAnimeList lacks a complete API of its own. Implemented endpoints follow the **Jikan v4 schema**, so an existing application can use Tenrai instead of or alongside Jikan by changing only the base URL. Please note that the API is in beta. Expect some rough edges and occasional downtime while we polish things. Thank you for being patient with us.
Patreon not yet available
--- ## Jikan v4 Notes Tenrai covers the public catalogue. Some Jikan endpoints are not available yet; we may add them in future.
AvailableAnime, manga, characters, people, producers, magazines, genres, seasons, schedules, top lists, reviews, recommendations and random
LimitedAnime /forum returns episode threads only and manga /forum chapter threads only; the filters all and other are not supported
Not available yet/users, /clubs, /watch, /random/users, and /userupdates for anime and manga
--- ## Auth & Rate Limits > Public requests work without credentials. Add `X-Server-Key` when you need higher throughput. Limits are enforced by tier. | Access | Header | RPM | RPS | RPD | |---|---|---:|---:|---:| | **Public** | *(none)* | 120 | 4 | Unlimited | | **Server Key** | `X-Server-Key` | 300 | 5 | Unlimited | Once a limit is exceeded, the API returns `429 Too Many Requests`. When you receive `429 Too Many Requests`, wait for the `Retry-After` value before retrying. Requests resume automatically after the window resets. Public limits are counted per IP address, Server Key limits per key. ### Server Key request example Pass your Server Key in the `X-Server-Key` header: ```bash curl "https://api.tenrai.org/v1/anime/38680/full" \ -H "X-Server-Key: YOUR_SERVER_KEY" ```
Keep your Server Key in server-side code and never expose it in browser or mobile client code. Server Keys are not Bearer tokens, so `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_SERVER_KEY` is not supported.
--- ## Server Keys Server Keys are private keys reserved for **[Patreon supporters](https://www.patreon.com/TenraiAPI)**. They offer higher rate limits for large-scale data work. - Despite the name, they are standard API keys that work in any project: servers, local scripts, personal databases. - Limits are enforced per key, not per IP, so a Server Key cannot raise the limits for users of a client-side or mobile app. - Server Key requests use their own cache, which keeps responses for 10 minutes, so recent data arrives sooner.
You can obtain a free temporary Server Key through our [Discord](https://discord.gg/MQ3X3sjdgK) server.
--- ## SFW Filtering SFW filtering is content-based. SFW-capable endpoints support two modes; strict mode also filters out `Ecchi`. | Mode | Parameter | Filtered Out | |---|---|---| | **Normal SFW** | `?sfw` | `R+ - Mild Nudity`, `Rx - Hentai`, `Hentai`, `Erotica` | | **Strict SFW** | `?sfw-strict` | `R+ - Mild Nudity`, `Rx - Hentai`, `Hentai`, `Erotica`, `Ecchi` | --- ## Caching & Data We pre-gather data algorithmically on a dynamic schedule. This difference in architecture is what allows us to offer higher rate limits, better stability and features that are unavailable in Jikan. Popular, currently airing, newly released entries etc... are updated daily and much more frequently, while older and less active titles are updated less frequently. For example: Currently airing One Piece is updated on site much more frequently than a title like Clannad that finished long ago. One Piece will therefore have a higher priority in our systems than Clannad. Scores, member statistics, rankings, metrics, things that are highly dynamic etc... are always refreshed daily regardless of entry age or status. Newly added MAL entries are made available within a few hours. Every response carries an `ETag` header. Send its value in `If-None-Match` on your next request, and you get an empty `304 Not Modified` if nothing has changed. A `304` still counts toward your rate limit. Public API responses are cached for a few hours up to a maximum of 12 hours depending on endpoint. Server Key users largely bypass this. You will notice that on some areas our data updates are much faster than Jikan, while on other areas we are slower. If you notice any issues with persistent stale data, please report it so we can refine the system. Our goal is to find the perfect balance between the amount of outbound requests and data freshness. --- ## Version 2 Version 1 (v1) is an interim version: a bridge between Tenrai and Jikan, so that an alternative to Jikan exists. It will not be perfectly polished, and we aim to move to v2 as quickly as possible. Version 2 will be the API we actually want to build, a big upgrade over anything currently available.
When v2 is available, there will be several months of notice before v1 is discontinued. For updates, join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/MQ3X3sjdgK) server.
--- ## JSON Error Response > Non-2xx error responses use a consistent JSON envelope with a machine-readable `type`, human-readable `message`, and request `path`. ```json { "status": 404, "type": "ResourceNotFoundException", "message": "Anime with ID 0 not found.", "error": "The requested resource does not exist in our database or the ID is invalid.", "path": "/v1/anime/0" } ``` | Property | Remarks | |---|---| | `status` | HTTP status code returned for the request | | `type` | Machine-readable error category | | `message` | Human-readable explanation of what happened | | `error` | Additional context or recovery guidance | | `path` | Request path that produced the error | A record that does not exist answers with the type `ResourceNotFoundException`. An address that is not part of the API answers with `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` or `NotFoundException`. --- ## User Data This API only deals with public catalogue data. It has no endpoints for user-specific data such as profiles, animelists or mangalists. If you need user data, please use the [Official MyAnimeList API](https://myanimelist.net/apiconfig/references/api/v2). --- ## Usage Policy All use cases listed below should be perfectly fine:
- Educational and university projects - Data science and research - Mobile and desktop apps - Unofficial MAL clients - Browser extensions and scripts - Bots, including Discord bots - Personal projects - Media server and metadata plugins
And much more. Please note that we don't own the data provided by the API, so we don't really have a say in what you can and can't do. --- ## Contact
DiscordThe quickest way to reach us
contact@tenrai.orgPersonal matters; a reply is not guaranteed
security@tenrai.orgSecurity issues
--- ## Disclaimer This API is provided "as is" without any warranties, express or implied. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or availability of the data. Use of this service is at your own risk. **By using this API, you acknowledge that you are aware of, have read, and expressly agree to be bound by our [Terms of Service](https://tenrai.org/terms).** **Tenrai and this API are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by MyAnimeList.net or its parent companies in any way.** All MyAnimeList data is property of its respective owners.
